# AI Summary Helper

> AI Summary Helper is a browser extension (Chrome, Chromium-based browsers and Firefox, plus an Android companion app in beta) that summarizes web pages with the AI provider you choose (your own API key or a local Ollama model), follows sites with a built-in RSS reader, saves pages into a searchable on-device archive, and sends reading digests to Kindle or LocalSend. Search, de-duplication and recommendations run on the device.

## Key facts
- Free for everyone. A donation (Support Pass) unlocks byphil Cloud with many AI models and supports all byphil tools.
- Bring your own key or run fully local with Ollama: only the summarization request leaves the browser.
- Install (Chrome): https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ai-summary-helper-openai/hldbejcjaedipeegjcinmhejdndchkmb
- Install (Firefox): https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/ai-summary-helper/
- Live demo (runs in the browser, nothing is sent anywhere): https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/demo/
- Android companion app (beta): https://github.com/philffm/ai-summary-helper/releases/latest/download/aish-companion.apk
- Source code: https://github.com/philffm/ai-summary-helper
- Maker: byphil (https://byphil.eu/)

## Pages
- [AI Summary Helper: summarize, save, search the web](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/): Chrome extension that summarizes pages with AI, reads your RSS feeds and keeps a searchable archive. Search and recommendations run on your device.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/privacy.html): How AI Summary Helper handles data: API keys and history stay on your device, and page text goes only to the AI provider you choose.
- [Create your bookmarklet](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/bookmarklet.html): One-click AI summary bookmarklet for any browser, including iOS. Use byPhil Cloud without a key, or bring OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek or Ollama.
- [Pocket alternative with AI summaries and Kindle digest](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/pocket-alternative/): Free, open-source Chrome extension: save articles, get an AI summary, send a digest to your Kindle. Own AI key or fully offline.

## Blog
- [Blog](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/): Notes on reading, search, and building on-device — from the team behind AI Summary Helper.
- [Videos](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/videos.html): Short videos of AI Summary Helper: summaries with sources, your language, a knowledge graph, feed recaps, Kindle and local models.
- [Use Your Library in Claude, LM Studio and Cursor](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/ai-apps-mcp.html): Connect AI Summary Helper to Claude Desktop, LM Studio, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP app on your computer. Your saved articles, highlights and collections, available to your AI app, without a server in between.
- [One Recap Instead of 40 Feeds](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/feeds-recap.html): Following many feeds means many small task switches. Here is how a daily or weekly recap replaces most of them, and why that matters for focus.
- [You Won't Read What You Save](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/unread-saves.html): Most bookmarked articles are never reopened. Here's why Digest exists, and why it deliberately doesn't try to make the pile bigger.
- [Check an AI Summary Against Its Source](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/verify-ai-summary.html): An AI summary is only useful if you can trust it. Here is a quick way to check any answer against the page it came from, and what a quote can and cannot prove.
- [Your Key. Your Model. Your Data.](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/bring-your-own-key.html): What bringing your own API key actually means for a browser extension: where your key lives, where page text goes, and what changes if you use a local model.
- [Pocket Alternative: What Matters](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/pocket-alternative.html): Pocket shut down in 2025. A decision guide to picking a replacement based on what you actually used it for, not which app looks the most familiar.
- [From Bookmarklet to 2.0](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/from-bookmarklet-to-2.html): It started as a bookmarklet for one person's Kindle habit. Here's what changed between v1 and the open-source 2.0 rebuild — and why.
- [Ask About Your Highlights](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/highlighting-vs-asking.html): Highlighting ranks among the least useful study techniques. Why it still feels productive, and a small change that makes a highlight stick.
- [Search and Tags Without the Cloud](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/on-device-architecture.html): The TF-IDF index behind AI Summary Helper's search, duplicate detection, and digest features — and why most of it never needed a server.
- [Sync Your Reading Library to Nextcloud, S3 or a Folder, Encrypted](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/sync-to-nextcloud-s3-or-a-folder.html): Step by step: keep your saved articles, highlights and notes in sync between devices on your own Nextcloud, S3 bucket or a local folder, encrypted in the browser.
- [Digital Sovereignty for Individuals: A Practical Guide (2026)](https://ai-summary-helper.byphil.eu/blog/digital-sovereignty-for-individuals.html): Digital sovereignty is not only for governments. What it means for your data, reading and AI tools in 2026, and a checklist you can follow in one weekend.

## Translations
Home page and main guides are available in 23 languages under /<code>/ (for example /de/): de, fr, es, zh, zh-tw, ja, ko, pt, hi, vi, nl, it, ru, uk, tr, id, pl, th, ar, sv, da, no, fi. Arabic (/ar/) is right-to-left. Every page declares its alternates with hreflang and lists them in the sitemap.
